name: Tabs
description: Tabbed panels with the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern from Zag.js (arrow keys, Home/End, roving focus). Without script every panel shows in turn under its own title, so no content is ever hidden from a reader or a crawler.

style.description: underline: a rule under the list, the selected tab underlined in accent. pills: the selected tab filled with accent.

orientation.description: vertical: the tab list beside the panel on wide screens (Elementor vertical tabs).

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour laid over the image, with its alpha.

size.description: How the image fills the section.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

items.description: Tabs in order (Elementor tabs tab_title/tab_content, Divi tab title + content).

heading.description: Section heading; also names the tab list.

label.description: Accessible name of the tab list when there is no heading.

id.description: Section id, unique per page: the tabs machine and its element ids derive from it.

a11y: Zag.js tabs: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected, aria-controls and aria-labelledby; arrow keys (per orientation), Home and End move between tabs. Before the script runs every panel is visible with its own title (an h3 under the section's h2, an h2 when there is no heading); after, the titles become screen-reader-only and the tabs label the panels.
